blocks.prompt: 20 Find the general solution of the differential equation \(y\,dx + x\,dy = 0\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh is exercise ka sab se chhota sawal hai, lekin is mein ek khoobsurat baat chhupi hai.
Diya kya hai? \(y\,dx + x\,dy = 0\). Find kya karna hai? General solution.
Rule kaunsa? Separable equation: \(xy\) se divide karte hi \(x\) aur \(y\) alag ho jate hain.
Baad mein hum dekhenge ke \(y\,dx + x\,dy\) asal mein \(xy\) ka differential hai, yani product rule ulta chal raha hai.
Plan: \(xy\) se divide, integrate, logs milana, log hatana.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(y\,dx + x\,dy = 0\).
Maloom karna: general solution.
Tareeqa: Separable equation: \(x\) wali cheezein \(dx\) ke saath, \(y\) wali \(dy\) ke saath, phir integrate.

Variables alag karein
\[\dfrac{dy}{y} = -\dfrac{dx}{x}\]
Kyun: \(y\,dx\) ko doosri taraf le gaye (minus ke saath) aur dono taraf \(xy\) se divide kiya; yeh maan kar ke \(x\) aur \(y\) zero nahi.

Integrate karein
\[\ln|y| = -\ln|x| + \ln|C|\]
\[\ln|xy| = \ln|C|\]
Kyun: \(\frac{1}{y}\) ka integral \(\ln|y|\) aur \(\frac{1}{x}\) ka \(\ln|x|\). \(-\ln|x|\) ko left le gaye to \(\ln|y| + \ln|x| = \ln|xy|\) ban gaya.

Log hatayein
\[xy = C\]
Kyun: Dono taraf sirf log hai, is liye andar wali cheezein barabar hain. \(\pm\) sign \(C\) mein chala gaya, aur \(C = 0\) se \(y = 0\) wala solution bhi shamil ho gaya.

Tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{d}{dx}(xy) = y + x\dfrac{dy}{dx} = 0\]
Yeh wohi \(y\,dx + x\,dy = 0\) hai \(\checkmark\)
Kyun: Product rule se \(d(xy) = y\,dx + x\,dy\). Yani di hui equation keh rahi hai ke \(xy\) ka differential zero hai, aur jis cheez ka differential zero ho woh constant hoti hai.
Dhyan dein: Exam mein yeh pehchan lein to ek line mein jawab mil jata hai: \(d(xy) = 0 \Rightarrow xy = C\).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key mein is sawal ka jawab number 23 par chhapa hai, 20 par nahi. Exercise 4.2 ki keys 2 se 29 tak hain jabke sawal sirf 25 hain (key 2 Question 1 ka jawab hai, aur keys 15, 19 aur 27 kisi chhape hue sawal ki nahi), is liye jawab 23 par dhoondiye, warna aap kisi aur sawal ka jawab dekh kar pareshan ho jayenge. Jawab khud, \(xy = C\), sahi hai.
